in_game_cockpit_camera.derivation: Canopy U(x,0,z+BodyAxisZ) minus config mass.cg, PilotEgress +Unity up*0.15, ChaseCamera +Unity up*0.1
in_game_cockpit_camera.convention: Angles from horizontal, up=-body Z; each side re-aimed at C with zero roll. Also report body-lateral fixed-axis projection. Default in-game camera looks forward/down 4 degrees; all bar endpoints are behind its forward plane, so actual visible angle errors are undefined. Re-aimed measurements are hypothetical diagnostics.
